01 • THE PROBLEM

WHAT CHALLENGE ARE WE SOLVING AT IIT ROORKEE?

Empirical Data: MDPI IIT Roorkee SWM Study | Slide 02 / 09
1. IIT Roorkee Empirical Solid Waste Audit (5,500 kg/day) 365 Acres • 12,000 Pop.

Per the published IIT Roorkee Architecture & Planning study, the campus generates 5.5 Metric Tonnes/day (0.46 kg/capita/day across Hostels 28.5%, Residential 31.1%, Academics 22.0%, Messes 9.5%):

Organic Food: 1,676 kg (30.5%)
Paper & Board: 1,580 kg (28.7%)
Plastic & PET: 613 kg (11.1%)
Inert + Leaves: 1,164 kg (21.1%)
2. Root Cause: Why Existing Campus Waste Systems Fail
• Broken Student Incentives: Zero personal reward for source segregation; existing complaint portals suffer from either student apathy or fake troll reports.
• Broken Worker Incentives: Sanitation staff get flat wages regardless of segregation quality, face English-only app barriers, and run blind tractor routes wasting 1,420 L/month diesel.
• Broken Scrap Market Value: Wet mess food dumped into dry paper bins destroys 60% of recyclable value (sold at ₹8/kg mixed vs ₹17.20/kg baled Grade-A).
Govind Bhawan Pilot: 200 Bins Monitored in Real Time Contamination = Value Loss
Key Insight: You cannot solve a 5,500 kg/day behavioral problem with plastic bins alone—you must align incentives. SOCIOTHON 2026

04 • INNOVATION & THE DIFFERENTIATOR

OUR CORE DISTINCTION: 4-WAY ECOSYSTEM INCENTIVE ALIGNMENT

Self-Enforcing Nash Equilibrium | Slide 05 / 09
Why Traditional Waste Apps Fail vs. Why EcoCampus Succeeds

Conventional apps rely on voluntary altruism. EcoCampus monetizes IIT Roorkee’s dry recyclables via B2B reverse auctions and locks every actor into a truth-telling game-theoretic loop:

1. Students (Anti-Griefing Tokenomics)

• +10 Tokens per AI-sorted disposal.
• +35 Tokens when Squad #2 verifies an overflow.
• -25 Token Penalty if worker photo proves a False Alarm (stops spam!).
• 1 Token = ₹0.50 at Nescafe & Night Mess.

2. Sanitation Crew (UPI Wealth Share)

• +₹150 instant bonus per verified cleanup.
• 30% direct revenue share of all B2B scrap auctions disbursed every Friday via UPI.
• Empowered by Hindi voice AI & load sensors (no lifting >35kg blind).

3. B2B Recyclers (Certified Purity)

• Direct access to baled, moisture-certified (<8%) Grade-A Kraft paper & PET.
• Raises campus scrap realization by +56% (₹17.20/kg vs ₹11/kg informal rate).

4. Self-Funding Circular Vault (₹1.49L+)

• 30% Student Canteen & Nescafe Pool
• 30% Sanitation Worker UPI Bonus Pool
• 25% IoT Sensor & Baler Upkeep
• 15% NSS Uttarakhand Flood Relief

05 • TECH STACK & ALGORITHMS

EDGE AI, SENSOR-FUSION TELEMETRY & COMBINATORIAL ROUTING

Production-Grade Architecture | Slide 06 / 09
1. EDGE COMPUTER VISION • MOBILENET-V3 SMALL (INT8)

Depthwise separable convolutions + Hard-Swish activation (2.9M params, 2.5 MB weights, ~12ms WebGL latency). Outputs Top-3 Softmax probabilities across 6 campus waste categories with live WebRTC camera capture.

2. IOT DUAL-SENSOR FUSION ANOMALY DETECTION (₹465 / BIN BOM)

Combines HC-SR04 Ultrasonic (volume fill %) + HX711 50kg Load Cell (mass kg) on an ESP32 node to compute Apparent Bulk Density: ρ = Δm / ΔV (kg/L) Dry paper has ρ ≈ 0.15–0.30 kg/L; wet mess food has ρ > 0.80 kg/L. When ρ > 0.65 kg/L in a dry bin, the node fires an automatic Wet Contamination Alert!

3. BILINGUAL VOICE AI & 2-OPT TSP OPTIMIZATION

• ElevenLabs Multilingual v2: Natural Hindi & English voice synthesis.
• 2-Opt TSP Tractor Routing: Visits only bins with fill ≥ 80% or mass ≥ 35kg, cutting fuel by 34%.
• Bazaar Valuation Formula: P = (B_cat × M_cond) + U_academic + A_free

Live ESP32 Ultrasonic + HX711 Load Cell Apparent Density Simulator
Stack: React 18, Vite, Tailwind CSS, MobileNetV3 WebGL, ElevenLabs API, ESP32 MQTT Telemetry. SOCIOTHON 2026
